lower_description: flat solid bright green chroma-key color, one uniform green, no texture, no shading, no dithering
upper_description: raised rectangular parchment panel plate for a 16-bit strategy game menu: aged cream-tan parchment paper face with ONE perfectly uniform flat cream-tan color across the whole face, absolutely zero texture: no fiber grain, no specks, no dots, no lines, no dashes, no rivets, no stitches, no inner borders, no creases, no blotches, no shading variation inside the plate, all detail strictly in the ornate outer frame: a wide richly carved dark walnut wood rim with visible wood grain strokes, a thin brass inner pinstripe where the wood meets the parchment, and a small round brass rosette pinned at each inner corner of the wood, gentle raised bevel lit from the top-left with a soft shadow on the bottom-right, retro 16-bit UI in the style of classic 1990s naval adventure games like Uncharted Waters 2 / New Horizons, crisp deliberate pixels, flat color fills, no text, no icons
transition_description: carved dark walnut wood rim with visible grain ending in a crisp straight edge, a thin brass pinstripe at the wood-to-parchment boundary, Uncharted Waters 2 wood-bound parchment panel edge
